The ref eventually invokes props.ref?.(readinessHost) (router-outlet.tsx:483). The optional injected callback can throw and is uncaught. Object descriptor construction and method bind also have unresolved facts; they do not erase this independent callback obligation.

showPastedTextInComposer invokes removeDraftAttachment and optional onDraftChange/getDraft APIs without a handler catch. Declared callback types supply no failure promise, so this is a contract-required handler obligation, not evidence of an observed rejection.
The optional callbacks.setOpen(false) call is uncaught. Optional chaining only skips the absent arm. With no resolved safe body for the supplied arm, D-129 requires the failure obligation.
